people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”
translations.bsb: We know that God spoke to Moses, but we do not know where this man is from.”
translations.kjv: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.
translations.asv: We know that God hath spoken unto Moses: but as for this man, we know not whence he is.
